itens.trecho: Ao assistir "Velozes & Furiosos 5: Operação Rio", eu vejo muito mais do que um simples filme de ação sobre carros, fugas e assaltos, porque, para mim, ele funciona como uma história sobre lealdade, pertencimento e conquista de liberdade em meio ao caos.

Fast Five brings the action, beloved old characters, exciting new ones, and a whole lot of fun to the Fast franchise and the heist genre. Fast 4 and Fast 5 are the best of the Fast & Furious franchise. Fast 4 redeemed the series after the failure of Tokyo Drift by bringing back Vin Diesel and the cast and family of the first film.

Picking up hot on the heels of the last film, the newly escaped "Dom" (Vin Diesel), his ex-FBI pal "O'Conner" (Paul Walker) and "Mia" (Jordan Brewster) have to keep skipping one step ahead of the pursuing law led by "Hobbs" (Dwayne Johnson) and, whilst cornered in Rio, they must assemble everyone with driving skills so as to thwart the ambitions of drug…
